symptom: `retrieve $C from $O/Ord_Cust;` (association written by its short name) passed `check -p --references` and exec and was stored as the association `.Ord_Cust` (empty module): mx check CE1613 "The selected association '.Ord_Cust' no longer exists.", and describe printed `retrieve $C from $O/.Ord_Cust;`, which does not parse
cause: addRetrieveAction built the association name as `s.Source.Module + "." + s.Source.Name`; the visitor leaves Module empty for a bare name, and nothing on the check side looked at a bare retrieve association at all. MDL-RETRIEVE03's qualifyAssoc guessed the start entity's module instead — a second answer to the same question
file: `mdl/executor/bare_association.go` (new: resolveBareAssociation, associationCatalog, generalizationChainFor, the shared refusal text), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (addRetrieveAction, qualifyBareRetrieveAssociation), `mdl/executor/validate_flow_member_refs.go` (new, check side), `mdl/executor/flow_member_spelling.go` (speller qualifies it), `mdl/executor/validate_retrieve_association_list.go` (qualifyAssoc)
insight: Resolve rather than refuse: exactly one association of the name with an end on the start entity's generalization chain (either end — a retrieve from the TO side is legal; a specialization inherits) is unambiguous, and every resolved shape built at 0 errors on 11.13.0, including `$Account/UserRoles` -> System.UserRoles. Refuse the rest, and never write the bare name: an empty module is CE1613 every time, so even 'cannot tell' (start entity unknown to the builder) is a refusal at exec, while check stays silent there. The resolver is a function of plain data (name, chain, catalog) so exec feeds it the project as earlier statements left it and check feeds project + associations declared BEFORE the flow — a later-declared one resolves at check time and not in exec's statement order. Resolving introduced a second spelling of the same member, so the describe speller (describedMemberSpellings) must qualify it too, or `create or modify` rewrote the flow on every re-run (asserted: 'Unchanged microflow')
fix: Bare retrieve associations resolve through resolveBareAssociation in the builder, the speller, MDL-RETRIEVE03 and check --references; missing/ambiguous are refused by check and exec with the qualified spelling; exec also refuses an unresolvable bare name rather than writing `.Name`
